title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film Reveals 4 Cast Members
content:
The staff of Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , unveiled a new visual and more cast members for the film on Friday, the same day as the film's opening . The staff also confirmed production on the second film in the series has been greenlit.

The new cast members include:

Nana Mizuki as Srajo

Akeno Watanabe as Nishagora

Shunsuke Takeuchi as Yataramar

Nao Tōyama as Sherumi and Yume Miyamoto as Menae

The returning cast members for the Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi film include:

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

The previously announced new cast members include Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste and Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli.

Masayuki Kojima ( Black Bullet , Tibetan Dog ) returned to direct the anime at the studio Kinema Citrus ( My Happy Marriage , The Rising of The Shield Hero ). Hideyuki Kurata ( Samurai Flamenco , The World God Only Knows ) was again in charge of scripts, and Kazuchika Kise ( Ghost in the Shell: Arise Alternative Architecture , xxxHOLiC ) and Yuka Kuroda ( Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ) returned as character designers.

Additional staff members include:

• Design Leader: Takeshi Takakura

• Art Directors: Osamu Masuyama, Teru Sekiguchi, Asaki Nakamura (Inspired)

• Color Key Artist: Miyao Yamashita

• Compositing Director of Photography: Tsunetaka Ema (T2 Studio)

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

• Sound Effects: Tōru Noguchi

• Music: Kevin Penkin

• Music Producer: Hiromitsu Iijima

• Music Production: IRMA LA DOUCE

• Music Production Collaboration: Kadokawa

The series' composer Kevin Penkin feat. Mori Calliope perform the film's theme song "Chain of the Abyss."

Kadokawa announced in January 2023 a sequel to the Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) anime.

The first 13-episode television anime series of Made in Abyss premiered in Japan in July 2017. Sentai Filmworks licensed the series and released it on Blu-ray Disc in October 2018. The English-subtitled version of the show streamed in the United States on Amazon 's Anime Strike service, and HIDIVE streamed the series outside of the United States.

Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) was the second season based on Akihito Tsukushi 's Made in Abyss manga. It premiered in July 2022 and ended with a one-hour finale in September 2022. HIDIVE streamed the series as it aired in Japan. Sentai Filmworks licensed the second season for release on digital and home video.

The Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul anime film opened in Japan in January 2020, and ranked at #9 in its opening weekend, earning 102,284,000 yen (about US$929,300) in its first three days. The anime film received 4DX and MX4D screenings. Sentai Filmworks premiered the movie in select theaters in the U.S. and Canada in August 2020. The film was scheduled to premiere in the U.S. in April 2020, but it was delayed due to COVID-19. Sentai Filmworks again screened the film in September 2020.

The first compilation film for the anime, Made in Abyss: Journey's Dawn ( Made in Abyss : Tabidachi no Yoake ), opened in Japan in January 2019, followed by the second film, Made in Abyss: Wandering Twilight ( Made in Abyss: Hōrō Suru Tasogare ), two weeks later. Sentai Filmworks premiered the first film in Los Angeles in March 2019, before it opened in theaters later that month. Sentai Filmworks premiered the second film in Rosemont, Illinois in May 2019, before it opened in theaters in the United States later that month. Both compilation films are streaming on HIDIVE .

In the story of Made in Abyss , an enormous pit and cave system called the "Abyss" is the only unexplored place in the world. Strange and wonderful creatures reside in its depths, and it is full of precious relics that current humans are unable to make. The mysteries of the Abyss fascinate humans, and they head down to explore. The adventurers who venture into pit are known as "Cave Raiders." A little orphan girl named Riko lives in the town of Ōrth on the edge of the Abyss. Her dream is to become a Cave Raider like her mother and solve the mysteries of the cave system. One day, Riko starts exploring the caves and discovers a robot who resembles a human boy.
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoto's 100 Meters, Buichi Terasawa's Goku Midnight Eye Manga for Release in 2027
content:
Mad Cave Studios' imprint Nakama Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga, and will release the first two volumes in 2027. Nakama Press will release the manga's first volume on February 17 and the second volume on April 27. Additionally, Nakama Press licensed Buichi Terasawa 's Goku - Midnight Eye manga, and will release the first volume on March 2. Nakama Press also confirmed with ANN that the new release date for Samurai Pizza Cats , a new 200-page middle-grade comic inspired by the Samurai Pizza Cats ( Kyatto-Ninden Teyandee ) anime, is December 8. The comic was first announced for release on April 7 of this year.

The company shared a cover and pages in English for 100 Meters .

Nakama Press describes 100 Meters manga 's story:

In 100 Meters , Togashi, a naturally gifted sprinter, has always outrun everything around him—until he meets a rival who challenges not just his speed, but his understanding of what it means to win. As their paths continue to cross from childhood into adolescence, what begins as a simple race evolves into an intense, psychological rivalry. Driven by talent, obsession, and the desire to prove themselves, both runners are pushed to their limits both on and off the track.

Uoto ( Orb: On the Movements of the Earth ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app in November 2018 as Uoto 's first series, and Kodansha published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume digitally in October 2019.

The manga's anime film adaptation premiered in Japan in September 2025. The film ranked #8 in its opening weekend, and earned 102,666,040 yen (about US$694,700) in its first three days. GKIDS screened the film in October 2025 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The film also screened in Los Angeles that October. The film won the runner-up award for Best Animated Film at the Florida Film Critics Circle Awards in 2025. Netflix began streaming the film with Japanese audio and English subtitles in December 2025.

Nakama Press describes Goku - Midnight Eye 's story:

After a brutal attack leaves him with a cybernetic eye, private investigator Goku gains the ability to hack any system with a glance. But in a world of high-tech crime and shadowy conspiracies, every answer comes at a cost—and the deeper he looks, the more dangerous the truth becomes. Goku, a hard-boiled private investigator in a near-future Tokyo where crime, corruption, and advanced technology collide, gains a powerful cybernetic eye that allows him to interface directly with computers. After a near-fatal encounter, he gains an edge in a world where information is the ultimate weapon. As he takes on dangerous cases that blur the line between human and machine, Goku is drawn deeper into a conspiracy that threatens to reshape the city itself.

Terasawa's three-volume manga originally launched in 1987. Yoshiaki Kawajiri directed the manga's anime adaptation at Madhouse , and Terasawa and Ryūzō Nakanishi wrote the script. The OVA released in 1989 and a sequel also released in 1989. Discotek released both OVAs on DVD in 2017. Discotek then released Goku - Midnight Eye on Blu-ray Disc under the title Midnight Eye Goku in 2023. The release marked the first Blu-ray Disc release of the OVA anywhere in the world. The release included two dubs: one from Urban Vision and one from Manga UK .

Update: Added Goku - Midnight Eye to headline.
author: ANN

title: 'Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi' Movie Second Part Announced
content:
The official website of the Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ) movie announced the production of a second part on Friday, as well as five additional cast and a second key visual (pictured) for the first movie. The first part premiered in Japan on Friday.

Cast Srajo: Nana Mizuki ( Boruto: Naruto Next Generations ) Nishagora: Akino Watanabe ( Free! Dive to the Future ) Yataramar: Shunsuke Takeuchi ( Ao Ashi ) Sherumi: Nao Touyama ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) Menae: Yume Miyamoto ( Josee to Tora to Sakana-tachi )

Made in Abyss adapts Akihito Tsukushi 's adventure fantasy manga , which began on the Web Comic Gamma website in October 2012. Takeshobo published the 15th volume on August 26. The manga has a cumulative 22 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in July 2017 and shipped the 14th volume on March 31. The 15th volume is scheduled for March 30, 2027 release. The manga has also been published in multiple foreign languages, including Mandarin and Korean.

title: Cosplay Trackside Returns to Santa Anita Park on October 24 & 25
content:
Cosplay Trackside, an Umamusume- themed cosplay meetup, returns to Santa Anita Park in Arcadia, California, on October 24 and 25, from 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. The event coincides with Santa Anita Park’s Japan Family Day, celebrating the racecourse’s partnership with Japan’s Oi Racetrack. Activities include several live DJ and cosplay performances, vendors, an artists’ and merchants’ alley, and live horse racing. Cosplaying is encourage but full face masks are not allowed.

The day’s cosplayers and performers include:

• ARETTEEPLS (Nym)

• CATWEENI

• CiellyCos

• Cheer♡UP!

• Dawnchurin

• enemies.to.lovers.arc

• Finchhasrabies

• HANNIUUUUUU

• KellyPlushie

• MIKOU_COSPLAY

• Sheliy Midori

• SHINYPINECHOU (Pinechou)

• Soft_DL (Soft)

• TRI.D.O.T

• YUMMI.JPG

Each day, the first 1,000 attendees will receive an official Umamusume : Pretty Derby x Santa Anita Park pin featuring Special Week. Life-size display cutouts of Special Week and Cesario will be set up in the Fountain Area near the Gate 8 main entrance.

Uma.guide, an Umamusume game guide website, will award contest winners 1/7-scale Sakura Chiyono O and Tokai Teio figures courtesy of Kotobukiya.

General admission tickets are available for $10 on the Santa Anita Park website. Special “Japanese Eats Start Pack” tickets cost $43.84 and include admission, a betting tip sheet, a commemorative gift, a $15 food voucher, and a sake-based cocktail.

The first Cosplay Trackside event took place on Saturday, May 16. Anime Corner interviewed one of its organizers.

Umamusume: Pretty Derby is a Cygames IP featuring anthropomorphic versions of real-world racehorses. It began as a mobile game and has since expanded into several manga, TV anime series, OVAs, a theatrical film, and additional games. Since the launch of the mobile game’s global version, various Umamusume fan events and track-endorsed cosplay races have taken place.

title: Frequent Ghibli Collaborator Joe Hisaishi Named LA Philharmonic's Composer-in-Residence
content:
Hisaishi's new role will include composing new works specifically for the orchestra. He will also hold recurring performances at the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and the Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles. The partnership includes "recording projects and educational and community engagement initiatives developed in collaboration with the Joe Hisaishi Foundation."

The Japanese government honored Hisaishi with the Order of the Rising Sun Award, Gold Rays with Rosette for his significant contributions to the country in 2023. The Japanese government awarded the composer with the Medal of Honor in 2010. Hisaishi was also awarded his sixth Japanese Academy Award for "Best Music" the same year.

title: One Piece Reveals What Its Greatest Power Is Really Made Of, And We All Got It Wrong
content:
One Piece is one of the biggest shonen series to have ever existed, and living up to the genre’s definition, the franchise also has one of the most suitable power systems. Almost every shonen series has a power system that defines its nature. Some great shonen series other than One Piece , such as Naruto , present this through the concept of Chakra, while Hunter x Hunter has Nen. While they differ in name, both power systems are generally similar, highlighting the power of the self and the energy that resides within characters. Although One Piece initially presented Devil Fruits as its main source of power, the series introduced Haki, which functions similarly to most power systems built around the energy residing within characters.

Even with Haki, the series introduced different categories, such as Armament Haki and Observation Haki, along with other concepts. However, the most prominent form of Haki was introduced with Shanks’ appearance. It was known as Conqueror’s Haki, which also has other names, such as the Color of the Supreme King . These names, along with characters such as Shanks wielding it, heavily implied that one had to be very special to wield this power. However, in the latest few chapters, through the depiction of this power in Sanji and Zoro, the series has changed this concept, and this new notion is honestly much better than what fans interpreted about this power earlier.

One Piece Reveals the True Hidden Secret of Conqueror’s Haki That We All Got Wrong

With Zoro, fans already knew that he possessed Conqueror’s Haki, as he had even displayed this power unintentionally against King and Kaido during the Wano arc. However, with the emergence of the God’s Knights, possessing this power became essential to hurting them. This is what the last few chapters of the series have focused on. However, the way Zoro was able to understand this concept stems from an intriguing statement by Mihawk, who revealed that having Conqueror’s Haki requires a sense of self. This implies that one must believe in themselves and their existence to be worthy of wielding this Haki. While this was a theory, Sanji proves that having Conqueror’s Haki requires believing in one’s self-worth.

Sanji had never displayed any signs of possessing Conqueror’s Haki in the past, although Scopper Gaban had told him that he had the qualities to wield it. One Piece revealed that what stopped Sanji from gaining this power was his lack of self-belief , as a flashback to the Kamabakka Kingdom revealed that he lacked self-love. He never believed in loving himself, instead sacrificing his body for others. Without this sense of self, Sanji never displayed Conqueror’s Haki. However, he is now beginning to love himself and recognize his self-worth, and it is evident that the series will grant Sanji Conqueror’s Haki through this development.

On a deeper level, characters such as Luffy, Whitebeard, Shanks, Roger, Loki, and many others who possessed Conqueror’s Haki always had confidence and unwavering self-worth. One Piece has always presented what its most important power truly represents, and it is profound that this greatest power was concealed within such a human and relatable concept. It proves that despite being filled with fantastical elements, One Piece is a shonen series that aims to educate readers about the nuances of life and the importance of building confidence, all while providing an intriguing narrative that has continued for almost 30 years.

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement for Fall 2026 Reveals Its Main Action Element, And It’s Anything Unlike Seen Before
content:
Crunchyroll has the perfect replacement for Solo Leveling in Fall 2026, and its latest episode has introduced an action element unlike anything you could have expected. More anime like Solo Leveling have become a trend, especially those adapted from webtoons. This year already saw Tomb Raider King , which made a strong impression on fans this summer due to its strikingly similar visuals. Now, Fall 2026 has Overgeared , which immediately emerged as an anime similar to Solo Leveling with its first episode. The anime is also based on a Korean webcomic and features a protagonist who levels up in a game-like environment.

However, what makes Overgeared different from Solo Leveling is its hilarious twist on the level-up trope. title: Kumo Kagyu's Moscow 2160 Manga Listed to End With 5th Volume
content:
Amazon Japan is listing the fifth compiled book volume of Kumo Kagyu and artist Kōtarō Sekine 's Moscow 2160 manga as the end for the series. The volume ships on December 25.

Yen Press p ublishes the manga and light novel in English and describes the story:

In the near future of a world whose history diverges from our own, the Soviet Union remains intact and the Cold War has continued for two centuries. Cyborg thieves and rogues roam the streets, and the powers that be conspire in secret… In the far north city of Moscow, the people's will, prosperous futures, and rights to freedom and truth have long been lost to war. But there lives a certain man with antique machine guns always in tow, beholden to no organization, whom they call a “Janitor”…

Sekine and Kagyu launched the manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in December 2022. Noboru Kannatsuki is credited with the character design. Square Enix shipped the fourth volume in December 2025.

SB Creative released a light novel adaptation by Kagyu in June 2023.

The anime adaptation of writer Kumo Kagyu and illustrator so-bin 's Blade & Bastard light novel series will premiere in 2027.

Kagyu ( Goblin Slayer! ) and so-bin ( Overlord ) launched the light novel series in December 2022. Drecom published the light novel series' sixth volume on March 10.

Makoto Fugetsu launched the manga adaptation on Drecom 's website in June 2023. Drecom published the manga's eighth volume also on March 10. Yen Press licensed the manga and released the fourth volume in English on June 23.

SB Creative published the first volume of Kumo Kagyu 's Goblin Slayer! dark fantasy novel series in February 2016, and Kōsuke Kurose ( The IDOLM@STER Neue Green for Dearly Stars ) launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Big Gangan in May 2016. Yen Press has licensed both Kumo Kagyu 's Goblin Slayer! novels and Kōsuke Kurose 's manga adaptation. The novels have inspired spinoff novels and manga series.

The first season premiered in Japan in October 2018, and Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles as it aired. Funimation also streamed the series with an English dub . The second season for the anime premiered in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed an English dub for the series.

title: 15 Years Later, A Sci-Fi Classic Returns With New Crunchyroll Dub Release
content:
It’s already been more than 15 years since Steins;Gate made its debut, but the anime has only just begun streaming the English dub. As the largest anime streaming platform around the world, Crunchyroll is home to over a thousand anime shows and movies. However, even though the platform’s library is vast, it doesn’t have everything fans would want. This also includes Dub releases for several classics that were added to the platform later on. Steins;Gate premiered in April 2011 and easily became one of the highest-rated psychological anime of all time. First released as a visual novel in 2009, the franchise would receive an anime adaptation in 2011 that helped spread the story all across the world.

However, with the dub unavailable for several years, it was more difficult for fans who are not used to watching anime in the subbed version. The official website of Crunchyroll confirmed on October 19th, 2026, that the anime has begun streaming the English dub of all 24 episodes. Crunchyroll also confirmed the voice actors of the main characters, including J. Michael Tatum as Rintaro, Trina Nishimura as Kurisu, Ashly Burch as Mayuri, Tyson Rinehart as Itaru, and Cherami Leigh as Suzuha.

Steins;Gate Returned With a New Release This Year

This summer Steins;Gate returned following a major delay, giving Rintaro Okabe another crack at travelling the timeline. On August 20th this year, Steins;Gate Re:Boot arrived on quite a few video game platforms. It serves as the full visual novel remake of the 2009 original game developed by MAGES and published by Spike Chunsoft. Originally set to release last year in 2025, the remake returned to the franchise’s roots, dropping the latest entry on Nintendo Switch & Switch 2, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Steam. The gameplay is set in the scenario of Steins;Gate Elite with faster pacing. All characters, backgrounds, and event stills have been redrawn from scratch, resulting in a major update compared to before. Compared to the Xbox 360 version, the number of event stills approximately doubled, and the background graphics have increased by approximately 1.2 times.

Steins;Gate Is One of the Most Unique Stories Ever

As a time-travel anime involving deep emotional connections and the consequences of such a power, Steins;Gate is highly addictive if you love a mystery anime and are deeply invested in it. At first, the prospect of time travel might seem like an exciting breakthrough, but it soon becomes clear through cycles of psychological torment that not everything is as it may seem. Despite his overwhelming enthusiasm, Rintaro Okabe, a self-proclaimed scientist, and his team have only managed to create a microwave that seemingly only has the odd ability to transform bananas into green goo.

At first, when he discovers that the microwave can be used for time travel itself, it seems like a groundbreaking scientific innovation, but things soon spiral out of control. As the situation turns from bad to worse, the discovery garners unwanted attention, and Okabe soon learns that time travel isn’t just a toy, but leads to dire, traumatizing consequences for both his loved ones and his own sanity. Realizing all too late the damage that’s been done, Okabe realizes he needs to move time itself to set things right.

title: K Manga Adds Shinobu Ohtaka's Geekrown Manga
content:
Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday that it is adding Shinobu Ohtaka 's Geekrown (also known as Geek and Crown ) manga on October 26.

The manga launches on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app on October 27. The original announcement teased that the story will center on a treasonous military officer in the middle of a succession crisis.

Ohtaka ( Magi ) launched the Orient manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in May 2018. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in February 2021. The manga entered its final arc in July 2023, and ended in October 2024. Kodansha published the manga's 22nd and final compiled book volume in November 2024. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and released the 20th volume on April 14.

The first cours (quarter of a year) of the manga's anime adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime, and also streamed an English dub . The anime's second cours premiered on TV Tokyo in July 2022, and covered the "Awajishima Gekitō-hen" (Fierce Battle at Awaji Island Arc) of the original manga. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime's second cours , and an English dub .
